title: Per-endpoint observability for vector-ranker: dashboards, tracing, and cost attribution
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Goal: Deliver per-endpoint (per-API-path) observability for the vector-ranker/embedding-rerank service so product owners and SREs can: (1) see quality + latency trends at endpoint granularity, (2) attribute inference cost to customer routes, and (3) receive actionable alerts when rank quality or cost per request regresses. This ticket captures the roadmap, telemetry schema, dashboard surface area, tracing conventions, sampling strategy, alert definitions, and rollout plan. The work targets hosted and Dedicated routing layers first, with Private rollout planned as a follow-up.
acceptance_criteria: Telemetry: per-endpoint metrics emitted for request_count, avg_lat_ms, p95_lat_ms, avg_rank_time_ms, kv_cache_hit_ratio, avg_embeddings_tokens, gpu_seconds, and inference_errors
Tracing: consistent span names and tags for endpoint, model_variant, batch_size, and cache_hit with sampling that preserves 1 in 10 infrequent-failure traces and 1 in 100 success traces
Cost attribution: dashboard shows token-based and GPU-seconds based cost per endpoint and a time-windowed change view (7d / 30d)
Dashboards: one per-endpoint summary dashboard and a cross-endpoint cost-slice dashboard available in Console with drilldowns to traces and logs
Alerts: SLO/SLI-based alerts for endpoint-level p95 latency, error-rate, and cost-per-1000-requests; alerts route to SRE and product owner with runbook links
Runbook: playbook created with prioritization, mitigation steps, rollback plan, and example queries/filters
Backfill: historical 30-day aggregation available for top 50 endpoints via nightly job
Instrumentation rollout: can be toggled per-cluster and per-deployment via feature flag
tasks: Define telemetry ingestion schema and update proto/schema registry (metrics + enums for endpoint_id, model_tag)
Implement metric emitters in ranker-service: counters/gauges/histograms per-endpoint
Add span instrumentation around prefilter->embed->score->rerank stages with standardized tags
Create sampling policy: error-heavy traces sampled at 10% min, success traces sampled at 1% with priority stamping
Build Console dashboards: Endpoint Overview, Cost Allocation, Latency Heatmap, and Trace Explorer link panels
Author alerts and SLOs in Alertmanager/console and wire to PagerDuty + Slack channels
Nightly aggregation job to compute 30-day baselines and store in telemetry-timeseries (backfill for top N endpoints)
Create runbook and postmortem template; add links to dashboards and GitHub PRs
E2E test: generate synthetic traffic (low/medium/high diversity) and validate metrics/traces and alert firing in staging
notes: We intentionally decouple cost attribution from business billing. This ticket focuses on internal visibility (GPU-seconds and token counts) rather than customer invoice changes. Private customers will get the same telemetry but delivery may require connectors to their internal telemetry stacks.
implementation_details: Span naming: ranker.request.{endpoint_id}.{model_short}; sub-spans: prefilter, embed.encode, embed.search, score, rerank. Tag set: endpoint_id, customer_tier, model_variant, batch_size, cache_hit (bool), tokens_in, tokens_out, gpu_seconds. Metric buckets: latency histograms with exponential buckets from 1ms to 30s. Emission cadence: histograms/summary at request completion; counters for errors at occurrence. For cost calculation use weights: gpu_seconds * gpu_rate + tokens_out * token_price_estimate. Store per-endpoint rollups every minute to long-term TSDB
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: high-cardinality endpoint tagging could blow up metrics cardinality. Mitigation: canonicalize endpoint_id to a limited namespace and support 'endpoint_alias' for UI; only top 500 endpoints exported to long-term aggregation by default. Risk: tracing volume. Mitigation: implement priority sampling and adaptive sampling during spikes.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (staging): metrics + spans emitted to test tenant (2 weeks). Phase 2 (hosted+Dedic): opt-in rollout to 20% endpoints, validate dashboards and runbooks (3 weeks). Phase 3 (full): enable by default for all routes with top N backfills (2 weeks). Private: document connector and provide instrumentation bundle (TBD).
estimated_cost_impact: Expected telemetry storage delta: ~15% increase in metrics ingestion for top 100 endpoints; trace storage increase estimated at 8% with sampling plan. Expected improvement: reduction of undiagnosed incidents >80% and faster MTTR for rerank regressions.
